description: This Scala source file defines the StatefulSetPodsAllocator class, which manages Kubernetes StatefulSets for Spark executor pods within the Spark Kubernetes scheduler backend. It handles creating, scaling, and deleting StatefulSets, and manages associated resources like PersistentVolumeClaims.

classes.name: StatefulSetPodsAllocator
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes StatefulSets for Spark executor pods, including creation, scaling, and cleanup, with resource and volume management.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the allocator with application ID and waits for the driver pod to be ready.

methods.name: setTotalExpectedExecutors
methods.description: Sets the expected number of executors per resource profile.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether an executor ID has been deleted (always returns false in current implementation).

methods.name: setTargetExecutorsReplicaset
methods.description: Creates or scales a StatefulSet for a given resource profile and application ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up StatefulSets associated with the application ID.
